## 2024-08-05 - Accessible Plots & Histograms in Data Science Notebooks
**Learning:** Default plots and histograms in Jupyter Notebooks (such as those generated by pandas `Series.hist()`) often lack crucial metadata like explicit titles, labeled axes, and distinguishable color styling. For colorblind accessibility and general usability, plots must combine distinguishable markers and line-styles (e.g. solid vs dashed lines with 'o' vs 'x' markers), explicit titles, labeled axes with appropriate units, and proper legend positioning to avoid data overlap.
**Action:** Always verify that line plots use unique marker-linestyle combinations and that histograms are styled with explicit titles, labeled axes with units, and distinguishable fills/edges. Clear cell outputs and execution_count fields when updating notebook cells to ensure clean re-running.
